description: This file defines a module for creating and managing menu text with rich color formatting for a CLI application, particularly related to trading or financial data. It includes a class 'MenuText' that handles constructing menu elements with color tags, truncating text, and managing command providers.

classes.name: MenuText
classes.description: A class designed to generate styled menu text with rich colors for CLI display, including methods for adding commands, menus, info, and settings.

methods.name: __init__(self, path: str = "")
methods.description: Initializes an instance with optional path, sets up text, path, and warnings.

methods.name: List _get_providers(command_path: str)
methods.description: Retrieves preferred providers for a given command path from an external reference.

methods.name: str _format_cmd_name(self, name: str)
methods.description: Truncates and formats command names to fit within defined length, handling underscores and generating warnings if truncation occurs.

methods.name: str _format_cmd_description( self, name: str, description: str, trim: bool = True )
methods.description: Truncates command descriptions to fit within a maximum length, appending ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: add_raw(self, text: str, left_spacing: bool = False)
methods.description: Appends raw text to the menu text, optionally with left spacing.

methods.name: add_info(self, text: str)
methods.description: Appends informational text formatted with [info] tags.

methods.name: add_cmd(self, name: str, description: str = "", disable: bool = False)
methods.description: Adds a command entry with name, description, optional disable state, and provider info.

methods.name: add_menu( self, name: str, description: str = "", disable: bool = False, )
methods.description: Adds a menu header with optional description and disable flag.

methods.name: add_setting(self, name: str, status: bool = True, description: str = "")
methods.description: Adds a setting item with status indicator and optional description.

ctags.name: _format_cmd_description
ctags.signature: ( self, name: str, description: str, trim: bool = True )

ctags.name: add_cmd
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_cmd(self, name: str, description: str = "", disable: bool = False):$/
ctags.signature: (self, name: str, description: str = "", disable: bool = False)

ctags.name: add_menu
ctags.signature: ( self, name: str, description: str = "", disable: bool = False, )

ctags.name: add_raw
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_raw(self, text: str, left_spacing: bool = False):$/

ctags.name: add_setting
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_setting(self, name: str, status: bool = True, description: str = ""):$/
ctags.signature: (self, name: str, status: bool = True, description: str = "")
